title: MTX_Dr_Pepper_3
episode: A Tom Prince New Year's Eve

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: New Year's Eve in Las Vegas? Wow, this really is over the top!
And so, a short plane-ride later... Kim and Tom are in the fanciest restaurant in Las Vegas!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: More oysters? The shells are plated with gold!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm still trying to decide whether I want the truffle gnocchi or the lobster bisque.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Order them both!
And later on a secluded man-made beach at one of the Las Vegas resorts...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I rented out this part of the beach for tonight.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Is that why Jeeves is fending off those tourists?
Nearby, Jeeves fends a tourist off with a cane.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: And stay out, plebeian!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Exactly. But we'll leave the beach to them soon enough... I just wanted to bring you here for dessert.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: For dessert? What kind of dessert are we having?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Have you ever had fresh pineapple skewers with coconut shavings? I had some flown in from Fiji.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This is the best thing I've ever eaten in my life! I'm going to have to start baking with more pineapple...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm so glad you like it.
And at midnight...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, this has been the most magical night of my life.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So you think you could get used to living like this?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I mean, I don't need this `every` day, but once in a while, I guess it's nice to let you plan a date `your` way.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I don't need this [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] day, but once in a while, I guess it's nice to let you plan a date [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] way.

nodes.text: Kim pulls Tom close and gives him a kiss!
Congratulations! You helped Tom take Kim out on the best New Year's Eve date ever!
That's all for this mini-episode! See you next time and happy holidays!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow! You really are pulling out all the stops!
And so, a very long plane-ride later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yawn... This place is... Yawn... So fancy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yawn... Sorry, Kim, I forgot how `long` it takes to get to France...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yawn... Sorry, Kim, I forgot how [color=#e23b3b][i]long[/i][/color] it takes to get to France...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's okay... But... Tom, I've been studying this menu for twenty minutes, and I don't even know what most of these things on the menu are...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Is this written in French?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Of course. It wouldn't be a very good French restaurant if the menu was in English.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Good evening! Are you two ready to order?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Would you like a few more minutes? I can come back.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, no. We should order. By the time you get back, I might be asleep.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And besides, I want to make sure we're able to watch the ball drop at midnight.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Midnight? But it's 5 o'clock!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: How is that possible?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Er...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I... Made a slight miscalculation... And we were in the air when the ball dropped.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sorry, Kim... We missed ringing in the new year.
Oh no! Tom ruined Kim's new year! Try again and see if you can get the good ending!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Airport?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What kind of a second-rate date are you expecting? How could we leave town without the jet?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Where are we going?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: A mariachi band?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They're going to serenade us while we journey to dinner.
Kim and Tom climb into the limo as the band begins to play.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This date is already great!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What? I can't hear you over the band!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I said this `date` is `great!`

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You `already ate?` But we're going to `dinner!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]already ate?[/i][/color] But we're going to [color=#e23b3b][i]dinner![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know, it `is` a real `winner!`
And so, a few minutes later...
As the limo pulls up to the restaurant, the band stops playing, and Tom nearly shouts his last sentence...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And that's the moment I knew I was really falling for you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Huh? What are you talking about? I thought you were telling me an anecdote about your time in Argentina...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I was pouring out my heart to you!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe this mariachi band at such close proximity was a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It was very sweet!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, don't worry. There's no way dinner could possibly go wrong. Ah, I believe we're at the airport now...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom! I've never seen so many roses! This is amazing!
Kim dives into the back seat of the limo, and Tom follows her.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Two thousand and twelve red roses to ring in the new year... That's so romantic!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, there are two thousand and eleven red roses...
Tom pulls a single white rose from the bunch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And one white... For this last year that we've spent together.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom... That's... So sweet...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm glad you like it.
Kim takes the rose and kisses Tom!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, the limo's stopping.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We must be at the airport. Come, my lady. The rest of our evening awaits!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: For our New Year's Eve together three years ago, Tom hired a helicopter to hover above Times Square while we watched the ball drop!

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Are you telling me that can't compare to a day spent churning out sweets for my New Year's Eve party?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Actually, about that...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You make a good point. You know what? We won't be taking any more orders for the holidays.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Oh?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We're going to be closed. Tom's taking me on an extravagant date.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yes. Pull out all the stops.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: But... I was planning to order three hundred gingerbread houses!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sorry, I'll be too busy indulging to bake.
Porscha leaves in a huff.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Did you really mean it? I can take you out on a `real` date?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you really mean it? I can take you out on a [color=#e23b3b][i]real[/i][/color] date?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You know, I'm up for giving it a try.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Excellent! Leave all the planning to me. I'll pick you up at eight on New Year's Eve!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Great! Um... But first, we've got some cookies to get out of the oven...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Right!
And so, on New Year's Eve...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Everything has to be perfect today, Jeeves. I can't disappoint Kim.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: All is in order, young master. Why, I do believe this will be your finest hour.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I hope so.
Jeeves' phone beeps. He looks down at it.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Ah, very good. The limo has arrived.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I guess it's time to start this night off.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Good luck, sir.
A few minutes later, Tom steps out of his limo and runs up to Kim's door.
Tom rings the bell, and Kim throws open the door.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom! Happy New Year's Eve!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Are you ready for the most extravagant night of your life?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Great. Your limo awaits!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: A limo! So fancy!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And that's not all. Just wait till you see what's inside...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just a little something I set up earlier.
Tom leads Kim to the limo and throws open the door!

options.label: Two thousand and twelve long stem roses.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: She's... Not... Impressed... By... Money?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Kim, I thought if I told you about all the extravagant dates I'm capable of planning, you'd only scold me for not giving more money to impoverished orphans.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Not... Impressed... By... Money?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Are you okay, Porscha?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I simply can't believe it. You mean to tell me that you have no interest in a typical Tom Prince date?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Do you even realize what you're missing?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: A terrible time? You said you'd never had more fun in your entire life! Why... I think I have some pictures right here.
Porscha flips open her phone and goes to an old photo album.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Here's a picture of us kissing at the top of the Eiffel tower... And here's one of us shopping for diamond bracelets for my birthday!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I don't know, Tom, you look pretty happy.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: And here's the article where the London news covered Tom's purchase of a horse and buggy for me.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: 'Tom Prince tipped his hat to this reporter and said, 'I'm having a wonderful time and this is so meaningful to me.' Then he rode off with his beloved globetrotting girlfriend.'

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: And that's nothing compared to how Tom would take me out when we had a real reason to celebrate.

nodes.title: A Tom Prince New Year's Eve
nodes.subtitle: Because New Year's Eve comes but once a year...

nodes.text: Happy Holidays! Welcome to a special premium mini-episode of Surviving High School!
For this mini-episode, we're going to see what happens on New Year's Eve when Tom Prince takes his girlfriend, Kim, out for a night of extravagance!
But first, you might be wondering why Kim decided to go against her usual practical nature and indulge. So, this story begins at the bakery where Kim works...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, could you give me a hand with this tray of gingerbread cookies?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But of course.
Tom sweeps the tray out of Kim's hands and delivers it to the oven.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks. I really appreciate all of your help.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know how busy the holidays are for you. Besides, I'd rather be toiling away in a bakery with you than relaxing on even my finest yacht without you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That's very sweet of you.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Of course, if I could convince you to take a few days off and `join` me on a yacht...
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course, if I could convince you to take a few days off and [color=#e23b3b][i]join[/i][/color] me on a yacht...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, you know I'm not some rich girl who wants weekends in the Bahamas. All that stuff makes me feel a little uncomfortable.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know... But if you ever want to give it a chance, I can promise you that luxury is very easy to get used to.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom... I can't. I have to be here. What would my wonderful clients do if the bakery shut down for the holidays?
The bell above the door chimes as a new customer walks in.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: What a quaint bakery! Ahem, I'm here to place an order for the holidays and...

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Tom? Tom Prince? Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hello, Porscha.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: An apron... Flour on your hands... This... Tom, this looks like manual labor.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: There's nothing wrong with manual labor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Porscha, this is my girlfriend, Kim. She owns this bakery, and I'm helping her out for the holidays.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I see. So this... This is what you `do` now. Amazing. I never would have guessed you'd be reduced to... This.
nodes.text_bbcode: I see. So this... This is what you [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] now. Amazing. I never would have guessed you'd be reduced to... This.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: My, my. I only mean that the last time Tom Prince took `me` out on a date, it was a little bit different.
nodes.text_bbcode: My, my. I only mean that the last time Tom Prince took [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] out on a date, it was a little bit different.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You two... Dated?

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: Tom never mentioned it? Well, I'm sure our time together must pale in comparison to your little scullery dates.

nodes.speaker: Porscha
nodes.text: I mean, jetting to Paris for crepes and London for high tea, taking weekend expeditions to find the rarest and most exotic birds for my personal aviary...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It `is` hard to believe Tom never mentioned `any` of this...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] hard to believe Tom never mentioned [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] of this...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's only because...

options.label: I had a terrible time and it meant nothing to me.
